activeWord.doc: The word being spoken at time: {id, text, start, end, prog (0..1 through it)}, or null between words.

anatomicalLimb.doc: Anatomical two-bone limb: closed Bézier envelope with muscle profile, optional sleeve over [0, sleeve.end], cel shaded. S, E, Wr are points.

anim.doc: Interpolate a numeric param that may be keyframed: [[t, v], [t, v], ...] (t in seconds of the component's local time), eased in-out between stops.

backOut.doc: Overshoots a little before settling. Exactly 0 at 0 and 1 at 1, so "has it started" can be asked of the result.

cel.doc: Cel fill: base colour, a soft highlight crescent toward the light and a shade crescent away from it, all clipped to the shape (works on unions).

character.doc: A character at x, y: a cast member or a kit, with pose, emotion, gaze and pointing (list_components {componentId: 'codeOverlay_x'} notes the options); returns its joints.

clamp.doc: v held between a and b.

conversation.doc: The studio. opts: W, H, time, localTime, words, castTable, seats [{cast, role?, bio?, color?, name?}], title?, subtitle?, liveLabel?, camera ('auto' | 'wide'), lowerThirds (default on), intro (default on). A seat's colour defaults to the member's seatColor, then a palette.

conversationPlan.doc: A transcript spoken in turns, directed: {lines, poses, emotions, shots} — each speaker's keyframed poses and emotions and the camera's shots — cached per words array.

drawScene.call: drawScene(ctx, nodes, W, H, time, prog, words, env)

easeInOut.doc: Soft start and soft landing (cubic); t is clamped to 0..1.

easeOut.doc: Fast start, soft landing (cubic); t is clamped to 0..1.

easeOutCubic.doc: The same curve as easeOut, under its other name.

envelope.doc: A closed outline of varying width around a spine of points: the path of a limb, a ribbon or a brush stroke.

fitViewBox.doc: The scale and offset that fit a viewBox into a box under preserveAspectRatio: {sx, sy, tx, ty}.

follow.doc: Damped harmonic follower (follow-through / overlapping action). The response to `signal(t)` is integrated from rest over a fixed trailing window, so it is a pure function of time: frames render independently and in any order with identical results.

fx.dust.doc: Motes drifting in a box, twinkling as they turn in the light.

fx.ink.doc: Ink that grows from (x, y) upward into branches as progress goes from 0 to 1 — a trunk first, then forks, then twigs with a drop at each tip.

fx.rays.doc: Soft shafts of light from (x, y), fanning around `angle` (degrees, 90 points down); they breathe slowly.

fx.sparkle.doc: Four-point stars blinking around a point.

hand.call: hand(ctx, x, y, angle, pose, o)
hand.doc: An articulated hand at wrist (x, y) pointing along `angle` (radians). pose: open | wave | relaxed | point | fist | thumbsUp | hold.

hash.doc: A repeatable 0..1 for any number: the same particle lands in the same place on every frame and every render.

ik2.call: ik2(x1, y1, tx, ty, L1, L2, bendDir)
ik2.doc: Analytical 2-bone Inverse Kinematics solver: shoulder/hip (x1, y1) -> target (tx, ty) with bone lengths L1, L2 and bend direction (+1 or -1).

image.call: image(ctx, src, x, y, w, h, o)
image.doc: A picture fitted into the box x, y, w, h (px): a URL, a data URI, or a file the project imported (media/shot.png). fit 'cover' (default) fills the box and crops, 'contain' shows all of it; focus {x, y} (0..1) is the point of the picture kept in view and zoom (>= 1) how far in — keyframe the two from localTime to travel across a screenshot. radius rounds the corners; shadow (blur px) lifts it off the page; stroke outlines it. Returns false, drawing nothing, until the picture has loaded.

lag.doc: The follower's lag behind the signal: the overshoot that drives hair tips, coat hems and antennae.

layout.anchorTo.doc: A box of `size` placed outside `box` on `side`, `gap` px away.

layout.box.doc: A box given in pixels or 0..1 of the stage ({x, y, width, height} or {cx, cy, w, h}) as pixels with all eight fields.

layout.column.doc: n equal boxes stacked down area, gap px apart (default 24).

layout.fitInside.doc: Move (and if needed shrink) a box so it sits inside `area`.

layout.grid.doc: n boxes in cols columns filling area, gap px apart (default 24).

layout.resolve.doc: Push overlapping boxes apart along their least-penetration axis, keeping every box inside `area`. Boxes flagged `fixed` never move.

layout.row.doc: n equal boxes side by side across area, gap px apart (default 24).

layout.safe.doc: The area inside the margins m (a fraction, or {x, top, bottom}); 5% at the sides and 6% top and bottom by default.

lerp.doc: From a to b as t goes 0 to 1.

limb.call: limb(ctx, x1, y1, jx, jy, x2, y2, w1, w2, color, cuffColor)
limb.doc: A two-segment limb (root, joint, end) drawn as one tapered shape, w1 wide at the root and w2 at the end, with an optional cuff colour.

mix.doc: Colour a blended toward b by q (0..1). Both may be #RGB, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, rgb() or rgba(); the result is rgb() or rgba().

morph.doc: Morph between two paths: every subpath is resampled to n points by arc length and blended pairwise (missing partners collapse to a centroid).

mouth.doc: A mouth at (cx, cy) from viseme params plus a smile (-1..1).

mouthOpen.doc: 0..1 mouth opening for the word being spoken, pulsing once per syllable; 0 in silence.

osc.doc: A sine between min and max (default -1..1): freq cycles a second, phase in radians.

parsePath.doc: SVG path data as flattened subpaths [{pts, closed, len}], cached per string.

pathLength.doc: Total length of an SVG path, in its own units.

pointOnPath.doc: Point and unit tangent at fraction t of a path: motion along a path.

scenery.doc: A described place drawn from parts: spec {theme, inside, floor, pieces, ...} as the story component takes it, o {W, H, time, camX}.

seatDrop.doc: How far a seated figure's hips drop (local units) in a character style.

set.doc: Draw a set. Unknown names fall back to the studio.

setFloor.doc: The floor line of a set (by name, or a described place's own floor) in pixels of H.

shade.doc: amt < 0 darkens toward a cool shadow, amt > 0 lightens toward white.

speakerAt.doc: Who is speaking at time t (holding 0.3 s past a word's end), or null.

spline.doc: Dense spline samples through a few control points.

spring.doc: A spring settling on 1, t seconds after release: freq (default 14) sets the wobble, decay (default 6) how fast it dies.

story.doc: Draw the story at time t. opts: W, H, time, words, castTable, scenes, theme, fontFamily, camera.

storyScenes.doc: The scene timeline: [{scene, a, b}] in order, the first from 0.

svgLayers.doc: Multi-layer vector artwork authored in its own viewBox units: layers: [{ d, fill, stroke, lineWidth, gradient, strokeGradient, shadow, transform: {x, y, scale, scaleX, scaleY, rotate, origin}, opacity, trimStart, trimEnd, morphTo, morph, dash, lineCap, lineJoin, fillRule, blend, nonScalingStroke, layers: [...], clip }]  (clip: a path the group's children are cut to) opts: { viewBox, box: {x, y, width, height}, preserveAspectRatio, W, H, localTime }. Any numeric field may be keyframed as [[t, v], ...] over localTime.

svgPath.doc: Render any SVG path `d` string with optional stroke-trim animation.

taper.call: taper(ctx, pts, w0, w1, color, o)

text.doc: One line of text at x, y (px): o {size, color, align, weight, font, baseline}, defaulting to 36 px, the theme's ink, centred, bold.

viseme.doc: Viseme for the spoken word at `time`: the letter under the playhead picks a mouth shape (A/E/O/U/M/F/S/L), blended into the next one and eased open/closed at the word's edges.
